TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_level
TABLE.COMMENT: Academic levels (for example Undergraduate, Graduate); pass rules and policies can differ by level

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_grade
TABLE.COMMENT: The school's grading scale: letters with percentage range and grade points, and marks not used in GPA

FIELD.NAME: earns
FIELD.COMMENT: Marks without grade points: 1 when the course hours count as earned (for example P)

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_minpass
TABLE.COMMENT: Lowest passing grade, for a level, a program, a group of courses in a program, or one course

FIELD.NAME: groupname
FIELD.COMMENT: Group of courses in the program (for example Core); empty = whole program

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_policy
TABLE.COMMENT: Academic rules (standing, repeats, maximum time ...) as the school states them, school-wide or per level

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_term
TABLE.COMMENT: Terms with dates and deadlines

FIELD.NAME: withdrawcalc
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = last day to withdraw calculated from the term dates (school rule, else 60%)

FIELD.NAME: gradefreeze
FIELD.COMMENT: After this date final grades change only through an approved grade change

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_course
TABLE.COMMENT: Course catalog: course code, title, credit or clock hours

FIELD.NAME: prereqtext
FIELD.COMMENT: Prerequisites as written by the school

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_prereq
TABLE.COMMENT: Prerequisite courses (all listed are required)

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_program
TABLE.COMMENT: Programs: credential, level, credit hours (degree) or clock hours (non-degree)

FIELD.NAME: credential
FIELD.COMMENT: Award as printed, for example MBA

FIELD.NAME: credentialtype
FIELD.COMMENT: certificate, diploma, associate, bachelor, master, doctorate, other

FIELD.NAME: delivery
FIELD.COMMENT: Delivery as the catalog words it

FIELD.NAME: trackhours
FIELD.COMMENT: Hours of the one track a student chooses

FIELD.NAME: graderules
FIELD.COMMENT: Grade rules as written by the school

FIELD.NAME: residenthours
FIELD.COMMENT: Credits that must be earned at the school; empty = no minimum

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_progcrs
TABLE.COMMENT: Courses in a program outline (required, track option or elective, by group)

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_student
TABLE.COMMENT: One official file per student, linked to the Moodle user

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: inquiry, applicant, admitted, denied, deferred, enrolled, active, graduated, withdrawn, onleave

FIELD.NAME: withdrawdate
FIELD.COMMENT: Date of withdrawal (required when status is withdrawn)

FIELD.NAME: firstgen
FIELD.COMMENT: yes, no or unknown (first in family at college)

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_faculty
TABLE.COMMENT: One file per teacher or staff member; linked to a Moodle account when they have one. No pay or HR data

FIELD.NAME: nolms
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = never uses the LMS: no course pages, lands on the Student Records home page

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_faccred
TABLE.COMMENT: Degrees, transcripts, licenses and certifications on file for a faculty member

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_facqual
TABLE.COMMENT: Courses a faculty member is qualified to teach

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_history
TABLE.COMMENT: Change history: who changed which field of which record, when, old and new value

FIELD.NAME: relateduserid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user the record is about, if any

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Audit log: who viewed, changed, imported or exported which record

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_import
TABLE.COMMENT: Uploaded catalog spreadsheets and CSV files (the file is kept as the source record)

FIELD.NAME: summary
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: sheets read and skipped, gaps found

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_draft
TABLE.COMMENT: Imported items waiting for the admin to approve, fix or reject

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: Where it came from, for example Courses row 12

FIELD.NAME: problems
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON list of things to check

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_stathis
TABLE.COMMENT: Status history of a student: every change of status with date, who and note

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_reqdoc
TABLE.COMMENT: Application checklist: documents required for admission, for all programs or a level, credential type or program

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_appdoc
TABLE.COMMENT: Application checklist of a student: each document received, waived or missing, with date

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_admdec
TABLE.COMMENT: Admission decisions: decision, date, who, reason and conditions

FIELD.NAME: termid
FIELD.COMMENT: Admit term (for a deferral: the new term)

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_educ
TABLE.COMMENT: Prior education of a student: school, credential, date, country

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_emerg
TABLE.COMMENT: Emergency contacts of a student

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_demog
TABLE.COMMENT: IPEDS demographics of a student (optional; seen only with the view demographics capability)

FIELD.NAME: races
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma list of IPEDS race codes, or notreported

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_offer
TABLE.COMMENT: Course offerings: a catalog course taught in a term (section, instructor, capacity, linked Moodle course)

FIELD.NAME: moodlecourseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle course students are enrolled in

FIELD.NAME: meetdays
FIELD.COMMENT: Class days, e.g. tue,thu; empty = online or not set

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_reg
TABLE.COMMENT: Registrations: a student in a course offering, with status and final grade

FIELD.NAME: timeended
FIELD.COMMENT: Date of the drop or withdrawal

FIELD.NAME: gradesource
FIELD.COMMENT: moodle (gradebook, read only), staff, change (approved grade change) or teacher (posted by the teacher)

FIELD.NAME: override
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = a date, capacity or prerequisite rule was overridden by staff

FIELD.NAME: accesspending
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = the Moodle course enrolment waits for payment (billing)

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_hold
TABLE.COMMENT: Holds on a student (block registration), with who placed and who released them

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_saprule
TABLE.COMMENT: Academic standing (SAP) rules, school-wide or per level

FIELD.NAME: mincompletion
FIELD.COMMENT: Lowest completion rate, % of attempted credits earned

FIELD.NAME: maxyears
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum years from the first term

FIELD.NAME: maxtimeframe
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum attempted credits, % of program hours

FIELD.NAME: maxtransfer
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum transfer credit, % of program hours

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_stand
TABLE.COMMENT: Academic standing of a student per term: proposed by the standing run, confirmed by staff

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_xfer
TABLE.COMMENT: Transfer credit accepted from other institutions

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_grchg
TABLE.COMMENT: Grade change requests: reason, a second person approves or rejects, applied when approved

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_gradapp
TABLE.COMMENT: Graduation applications: applied, reviewed against the degree audit, conferred

FIELD.NAME: termid
FIELD.COMMENT: Term the student expects to finish

FIELD.NAME: state
FIELD.COMMENT: applied, approved, denied, conferred or cancelled

FIELD.NAME: auditsnapshot
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON of the degree audit at review

FIELD.NAME: conditional
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = approved while classes were in progress

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_letter
TABLE.COMMENT: Enrollment verification letters issued (kept as the record of what was released)

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_ferpa
TABLE.COMMENT: Annual FERPA notice: acknowledgment per student and academic year

FIELD.NAME: method
FIELD.COMMENT: online (by the student) or paper (recorded by staff)

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_relauth
TABLE.COMMENT: Release authorizations: who may receive which information of a student, and from / to which dates

FIELD.NAME: scope
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma list: enrollment, grades, financial, conduct, all

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_fee
TABLE.COMMENT: Billing price list: tuition and fees, what they are charged per, and for which programs

FIELD.NAME: basis
FIELD.COMMENT: hour, course, term, program, once, manual or late

FIELD.NAME: qualified
FIELD.COMMENT: Counts as qualified tuition and related expenses on the 1098-T

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_txn
TABLE.COMMENT: Student account lines (never changed or removed; a mistake is fixed by a reversing line). Positive amounts add to what the student owes

FIELD.NAME: txntype
FIELD.COMMENT: charge, credit, payment, refund or payout

FIELD.NAME: txndate
FIELD.COMMENT: Date the line counts from (for statements and the 1098-T year)

FIELD.NAME: method
FIELD.COMMENT: Payment method, or kind of credit (scholarship, waiver ...)

FIELD.NAME: reference
FIELD.COMMENT: Check number, transfer reference, payment provider id

FIELD.NAME: chargeid
FIELD.COMMENT: On a refund line: the charge it refunds

FIELD.NAME: aidid
FIELD.COMMENT: Federal aid module: the aid award a disbursement is for

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_payreq
TABLE.COMMENT: Online payments started by a student through Moodle's payment system: open until the payment provider confirms it

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The Moodle user who pays (the student)

FIELD.NAME: txnid
FIELD.COMMENT: The payment line on the account

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_plan
TABLE.COMMENT: Payment plans the school offers: down payment, number of payments, how often, due dates, plan fee, late fee and grace days

FIELD.NAME: scope
FIELD.COMMENT: Who can use it: all, level or program

FIELD.NAME: duemode
FIELD.COMMENT: relative (days after the term starts) or fixed (dates)

FIELD.NAME: firstdue
FIELD.COMMENT: Days after the term starts that the first payment is due

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_stuplan
TABLE.COMMENT: A payment plan given to a student for a term (from the school's plans, or custom with a note)

FIELD.NAME: planid
FIELD.COMMENT: The school plan it came from; null = custom

FIELD.NAME: total
FIELD.COMMENT: Amount the plan covers, plan fee included

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_inst
TABLE.COMMENT: Payments of a student's plan: down payment (number 0) and the payments after it, with due date and state

FIELD.NAME: paid
FIELD.COMMENT: Part of the amount paid so far

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_refrule
TABLE.COMMENT: The school's refund rules, in order: the first rule that fits the date of a drop or withdrawal gives the refund

FIELD.NAME: ruletype
FIELD.COMMENT: cancel, beforestart, adddrop, pctterm, days or after

FIELD.NAME: value
FIELD.COMMENT: Business days (cancel), percent of the term (pctterm) or days after the start (days)

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_refund
TABLE.COMMENT: Refunds figured when a student drops or withdraws: proposed by the refund rules, approved or rejected by staff

FIELD.NAME: eventdate
FIELD.COMMENT: Date the refund is figured on (drop, withdrawal or last date of attendance)

FIELD.NAME: details
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: each charge, percent and refund

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: proposed, approved, rejected or none (nothing to refund)

FIELD.NAME: duedate
FIELD.COMMENT: Date the money should be paid back by

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_msglog
TABLE.COMMENT: Automatic messages: which message, to whom, when, and whether it was sent or skipped (and why)

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: sent, failed, off, nouser or testmode

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_meeting
TABLE.COMMENT: Class meetings of a course offering (date and length), for attendance

FIELD.NAME: meetingdate
FIELD.COMMENT: Day of the meeting (noon, school time zone)

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_attend
TABLE.COMMENT: Attendance of a registered student at a class meeting: present, absent, late or excused, hours attended

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_export
TABLE.COMMENT: Saved outside exports: which students and which fields, for a state agency, an accreditor or others

FIELD.NAME: population
FIELD.COMMENT: all, active, term, admitted, graduated or withdrawn

FIELD.NAME: fields
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma list of fields in order

FIELD.NAME: headers
FIELD.COMMENT: Own column names, one per line

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_aid
TABLE.COMMENT: Federal aid module: aid awards of a student (fund, award year, amount, status)

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_wait
TABLE.COMMENT: Waitlists: students waiting for a seat in a full section, or applicants waiting for a place in a program

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_cart
TABLE.COMMENT: Self-registration: classes a student has picked but not registered in yet

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_subst
TABLE.COMMENT: Approved course substitutions in the degree audit: a course counts for a required course

TABLE.NAME: local_studentrecords_aidyear
TABLE.COMMENT: Federal aid module: a student's aid year details entered by Financial Aid staff (cost of attendance, Student Aid Index, dependency, grade level, verification, counseling)

FIELD.NAME: counseling
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = loan entrance counseling and promissory note done
